enabled.description: Discord Rich Presence: Shows your application's name, pictures, text lines and buttons on every player's Discord profile. Needs the application id. Off: players keep FiveM's own presence.

appId.description: Application id: On discord.com/developers open your application, General Information, and copy the Application ID (17 to 20 digits). It is public, not a secret.

largeImage.description: Large picture: The name of an Art Asset of your application: the big square picture next to the text, usually your logo. Empty: no picture.

largeText.description: Large picture text: Shown when someone moves the mouse over the large picture.

smallImage.description: Small picture: The name of an Art Asset of your application: the small round picture on the corner of the large one. Empty: no small picture.

smallText.description: Small picture text: Shown when someone moves the mouse over the small picture.

top.description: First line: The upper line, up to 128 characters. Updates by itself when a placeholder's value changes (the street at most every 15 seconds).

bottom.description: Second line: The lower line, up to 128 characters, with the same placeholders.

buttons.description: Buttons: Two at most, shown in this order.

label.description: Button text: The text on the button, up to 32 characters.

url.description: Link: The page the button opens; it must start with https://.
